svg.title: Retrospeq whole application flow
svg.desc: Broker data and trader input flow through ingestion into two independent engines, analytics and rulebook, which converge at the weekly review where findings graduate into rules.
svg.text: Independent engines — they never read each other

g.text: Shadow harness runs unproven ones silently
Adherence: hard and soft, never blended

svg.text: A rule may only reference a field that exists

g.text: Read first, decide second. Three prompts maximum, usually zero.

svg.text: Finding graduates into a rule, then is watched for decay
